properties.description: Lab detection correlating failed authentication, successful login, privilege change, sensitive file access, and data transfer in chronological order within 30 minutes.
properties.query:
// SOC-LAB-003: Multi-stage suspicious account activity
// Lab-only synthetic event correlation.
// Detects ordered activity within a 30-minute window.

SOCSecurityEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize
    FailedLoginTime = minif(TimeGenerated, EventType == "FailedLogin"),
    LoginTime = minif(TimeGenerated, EventType == "SuccessfulLogin" and Result == "Success"),
    PrivilegeTime = minif(TimeGenerated, EventType == "PrivilegeChange" and Result == "Success"),
    FileAccessTime = minif(TimeGenerated, EventType == "SensitiveFileAccess" and Result == "Success"),
    TransferTime = minif(TimeGenerated, EventType == "DataTransfer" and Result == "Success"),
    EventCount = count(),
    MaxRiskScore = max(RiskScore)
    by CorrelationId, UserId, SourceIP
| where isnotnull(FailedLoginTime)
    and isnotnull(LoginTime)
    and isnotnull(PrivilegeTime)
    and isnotnull(FileAccessTime)
    and isnotnull(TransferTime)
| where FailedLoginTime < LoginTime
    and LoginTime < PrivilegeTime
    and PrivilegeTime < FileAccessTime
    and FileAccessTime < TransferTime
| where TransferTime - FailedLoginTime <= 30m
| project
    TimeGenerated = TransferTime,
    UserId,
    SourceIP,
    CorrelationId,
    FailedLoginTime,
    LoginTime,
    PrivilegeTime,
    FileAccessTime,
    TransferTime,
    EventCount,
    MaxRiskScore
